description:
Audit signal:
- `cargo rustc -p fz --lib -- -D unreachable_pub` reports 655 unreachable public items; reduced to 357 function/method candidates.
- `cargo rustc -p fz-runtime --lib -- -D unreachable_pub` reports 17 function candidates, all under runtime/src/heap/gc.

Goal:
Restrict functions and methods that are not part of an exported crate API from `pub` to the narrowest correct visibility, usually `pub(crate)` and sometimes `pub(super)` where rustc suggests it.

Strategy:
Work subsystem by subsystem, preserving current behavior. After each slice, run the relevant targeted tests plus the lint command for that crate. Do not touch exported API in src/lib.rs (`run`, `FunctionSurface`, `compiler2`, `types`) or runtime C ABI/no_mangle functions unless separately justified.

Acceptance signal:
The function/method subset of unreachable_pub is gone for the touched subsystem, and normal tests still pass.
title: Restrict unreachable public functions to crate visibility
